snippet.title: Australia Did It - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396130/Australia_Did_It/
Join Our Discord Community: https://discord.gg/5ZvRud92eN

Australia Did It doesn’t just play with genres......it creates one! Enter the Tactical Reverse Bullet Hell, where thoughtful Turn-Based Tower Defense is enhanced by a unique unit merging system and explosive, pulse-pounding on-rails Reverse Bullet Hell Combat. Carefully strategize to withstand relentless enemy waves, then unleash sensory overload as you become the Bullet Hell, mowing down thousands in dazzling chaos.

Welcome aboard, mercenary! We have one simple company motto here: Cargo delivery is mandatory. Repairs are optional. 

Nobody knows what caused it, but decades ago a catastrophic event dried up the Atlantic Ocean, leaving behind a hostile wasteland crawling with oversized bugs, reanimated ancient weapons, and bizarre mutated creatures.

Your mission? Escort our clients’ precious cargo across this hostile terrain by train. You’ll hold off endless waves of enemies at every station. If the shipment arrives intact, we’ll call it a win. 

Australia Did It will be available on PC via Steam later this year. Wishlist the game now and follow along on Discord or TikTok for the latest news and updates.
